title_en: Sichuan Zhongcheng Coal Construction (Group) Co., Ltd. v. Chengdu Hongchang Jiatai Real Estate Co., Ltd. — dispute over a construction project contract
ruling_gist_en: In construction projects, the building materials and labor invested by the foundation pit contractor have been incorporated into the building and are inseparable from it; therefore, the contractor under the foundation pit construction contract shall be entitled to priority compensation.

full_text_en:
Sichuan Zhongcheng Coal Construction (Group) Co., Ltd. v. Chengdu Hongchang Jiatai Real Estate Co., Ltd. — dispute over a construction project contract

【Ruling Summary】

The contractor of a foundation pit project in a construction project has invested building materials and labor that have been incorporated into the building and are inseparable from the building; therefore, the contractor of the foundation pit construction contract should enjoy a priority right to claim payment.

For the same construction project, there may be multiple contractors. If the projects completed by the contractors constitute a construction project, and the jointly completed construction project is suitable for valuation or auction, the priority right to claim payment of the contractors should be protected in accordance with the law. According to industry management standards and measures for the construction industry, deep foundation pit engineering includes supporting structure construction, control of groundwater and surface water, and earthwork excavation. Therefore, where the contractor of a construction contract for foundation pit support, dewatering, and earthwork excavation and transportation requests a priority right to claim payment within the scope of the unpaid project funds, the people's court shall support such a request.

Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court

(2021) Zui Gao Fa Min Zai No. 188

Retrial Applicant (Plaintiff at First Instance, Appellant at Second Instance): Sichuan Zhongcheng Coal Construction (Group) Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 38 Qinghua Road, Qingyang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province.

Legal Representative: Ke Jun, Chairman of the Company.

Authorized Litigation Representatives: Du Lijuan, lawyer of Sichuan Shidai Jingwei Law Firm.

Authorized Litigation Representative: Ma Yuping, lawyer of Beijing Gaotong (Chengdu) Law Firm.

Applicant (Defendant at First Instance, Appellee at Second Instance): Chengdu Hongchang Jiatai Real Estate Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 76 Fangcao Street, High-tech Zone, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province.

Litigation Representative: Lei Jun, chief of the company’s administrator.

Authorized Litigation Representative: Wang Huan, staff member of the company’s administrator.

The retrial applicant, Sichuan Zhongcheng Coal Construction (Group) Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company), due to its dispute with the applicant, Chengdu Hongchang Jiatai Real Estate Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Hongchang Jiatai Company), over a construction project contract, refused to accept the civil judgment (2020) Chuan Min Zhong No. 1582 of the Sichuan High People's Court, and applied to this Court for retrial. On June 19, 2021, this Court rendered the civil ruling (2021) Zui Gao Fa Min Shen No. 3675, ordering a retrial of this case. This Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law and heard this case in open court. The authorized litigation representatives of the retrial applicant, Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company, Du Lijuan and Ma Yuping, and the litigation representative of the applicant, Hongchang Jiatai Company, Lei Jun, and authorized litigation representative Wang Huan, appeared in court to participate in the proceedings. The trial of this case is now concluded.

Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company applied for retrial on the grounds that: First, the foundation pit project in question is an inseparable component of the construction of the Strait Friendship Building, and its labor results have been materialized into the building itself, rather than constituting a change in or enhancement of the land. The deep foundation pit excavation, earthwork excavation and transportation, and support work completed by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company were constructed based on parameters such as the spatial structure of the basement of the corresponding building, the foundation stability of the high-rise building, and the service life of the building. These works have been integrated into the entire building and are inseparable parts of the building. From the perspective of construction technical specifications, foundation pit construction is an indispensable construction link for building construction. The construction by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company was a specialized and targeted construction in coordination with the basement and above-ground parts of the building. If the building's function, basement design, construction height, or foundation strength were to be changed, the foundation pit project would not be applicable. In terms of value addition, the labor results of the foundation pit construction in question have been materialized into the building itself, rather than being a change in or enhancement of the land to which it is attached. Moreover, according to the explicit agreement in the contract between the parties, the water resource extraction fee falls within the scope of construction project costs and payable project funds, and should be included in the scope of the priority right to claim payment. Second, the determination by the court of second instance that "the relevant projects constructed by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company involve changes to the current state of the land, have not yet formed a separate building or structure, cannot be auctioned or transferred, and therefore its claim for a priority right to claim payment for the project price is not supported" constitutes an error in the application of law. The term "project" in "valuation or auction of the project" as provided in Article 17 of the Interpretation (II) of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes over Construction Project Contracts refers to the single building into which the project in question is integrated, and is not limited to the part of the project completed by the claimant. This literal interpretation can be corroborated by the provisions of Article 18 of the same Interpretation concerning the priority right to claim payment for decoration and finishing project prices. Even if the value scope of the priority right is limited to the value of the constructed part, the enforcement auction should target the single building constructed by the contractor, rather than only the part constructed by the claimant being auctioned or valued. Third, from the perspective of legislative intent, the priority right to claim payment for construction project prices is intended to protect the rights and interests of migrant workers; the vast majority of the costs of the foundation pit project in question consist of workers' wages. In summary, the request is: 1. To reverse the latter part of paragraph 1 of the judgment of second instance, i.e., "to uphold paragraph 3 of the civil judgment (2020) Chuan 01 Min Chu No. 340 of the Chengdu Intermediate People's Court;" 2. To revise the judgment so that Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company enjoys a priority right to claim payment for the project funds of RMB 15,398,977.71 against the proceeds from the valuation or auction of the Strait Friendship Building located at Plot No. 8, Financial Headquarters Business District, High-tech Zone, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province; 3. The court acceptance fees for the first and second instance and the appraisal fees in this case shall be borne by Hongchang Jiatai Company.

Hongchang Jiatai Company argued in defense: First, the scope of the contract undertaken by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company is foundation pit support, dewatering, and earthwork excavation and transportation, which do not fall within the scope of the main works. These works involve changes to the current state of the land and have not formed a separate building or structure, thus they do not meet the conditions for separate auction or sale. Therefore, Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company should not enjoy the priority right to claim payment for the construction project price. Second, even if it is determined that Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company is entitled to the priority right, the scope it claims exceeds the scope provided by law. The existing works in progress, including the four underground floors and the four floors above ground, were not constructed by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company. The scope of its claimed priority right should not encompass the entire works in progress, but should be limited to the part it constructed. Third, the price for which Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company claims the priority right includes the water resource extraction fee, which is an administrative fee, not within the scope of the project price, and should be excluded.

Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company filed a lawsuit with the Chengdu Intermediate People's Court of Sichuan Province (hereinafter referred to as the court of first instance) requesting: 1. A judgment to terminate the "Design and Construction Contract for the Foundation Pit Support, Dewatering, and Earthwork Excavation and Transportation Project of the Strait Friendship Building (Tentative Name) Project" (hereinafter referred to as the "Design and Construction Contract") and its "Supplementary Agreement" and "Supplementary Agreement (II)" signed between Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company and Hongchang Jiatai Company; 2. A judgment ordering Hongchang Jiatai Company to pay Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company the unpaid project funds and liquidated damages totaling RMB 38,546,286.70, with the liquidated damages provisionally calculated up to April 30, 2019, and actually calculated until the date Hongchang Jiatai Company pays off all sums, and the dewatering shift fee provisionally calculated up to April 30, 2019, with Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company reserving the right to claim for subsequent expenses; 3. A judgment that Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company enjoys a priority right to claim payment against the valuation or auction proceeds of the construction project in question.

The court of first instance found the following facts: On October 27, 2010, Hongchang Jiatai Company, as the developer (Party A), and the contractor Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company (Party B) signed the "Design and Construction Contract," whereby Hongchang Jiatai Company entrusted Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company with the design and construction of all foundation pit support, dewatering, and earthwork excavation and transportation works within the scope of the project named Strait Friendship Building (Tentative Name) on Plot No. 8, Financial Headquarters Business District, Southern New District, Chengdu City. The contract stipulated a lump sum price of RMB 19 million, covering design, quality, schedule, and safety and civilized construction. Party B was not allowed to request changes for any reason. The "Design and Construction Contract" also contained provisions on payment of project funds, completion settlement, total project duration, and liability for breach of contract. Regarding payment of project funds, it was agreed as follows: For the foundation pit support works, dewatering works (excluding the maintenance period), and earthwork excavation and transportation works, upon completion of each works on schedule and after acceptance inspection and written confirmation by Party A, the supervisor, the general contractor, and relevant functional departments, settlement procedures shall commence.

On April 18, 2013, Hongchang Jiatai Company and Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company signed the "Supplementary Agreement for the Foundation Pit Support, Dewatering, and Earthwork Excavation and Transportation Project of the Strait Friendship Building (Tentative Name) Project" (hereinafter referred to as the "Supplementary Agreement"), whereby Hongchang Jiatai Company entrusted Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company with the supplementary part of the foundation pit support works of the original contract, i.e., the supplementary part of the foundation pit wall reinforcement construction. The "Supplementary Agreement" stipulated that the lump sum price for the works agreement was RMB 3.78 million; upon completion of all foundation pit wall reinforcement works and after acceptance inspection and written confirmation by Party A, the supervisor, the general contractor, and relevant functional departments, Party A, upon confirmation of receipt of a formal invoice recognized by Party A provided by Party B, shall pay Party B all remaining project funds under this agreement within ten working days.

On July 18, 2013, Hongchang Jiatai Company, as Party A, and Party B, Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company, reached an agreement through negotiation on matters including existing earthwork excavation and transportation, subsidies, and adjustments to the original contract, and signed the "Supplementary Agreement (II) for the Foundation Pit Support, Dewatering, and Earthwork Excavation and Transportation Project of the Strait Friendship Building (Tentative Name) Project" (hereinafter referred to as "Supplementary Agreement (II)"). The "Supplementary Agreement (II)" included clauses on settlement and payment of project funds, schedule agreements, and cooperation in project construction. It stipulated that upon completion of all earthwork excavation, transportation, and backfilling works (including the reinforcement and counter-pressure part) on schedule and after acceptance inspection and written confirmation by Party A, the supervisor, the general contractor, and relevant functional departments, settlement procedures shall commence; during project construction, Party B shall unconditionally cooperate with Party A, the supervisor, and the general contractor, and shall not obstruct the general contractor's construction for any reason or in any manner.

After the "Design and Construction Contract" was signed, Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company organized personnel to carry out the construction of the project. Hongchang Jiatai Company stated that the main works were contracted to Chengdu Construction Engineering Group Co., Ltd. for construction, and that the main works had been suspended since November 2015 and had not resumed as of that date. Chengdu Construction Engineering Group Co., Ltd. and Hongchang Jiatai Company were engaged in litigation over a construction project contract dispute.

During the trial at first instance, Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company applied for a cost appraisal. The people's court commissioned Sichuan Shuwei Project Management Consulting Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Shuwei Consulting Company) to appraise the completion progress and cost of the works under the "Design and Construction Contract," "Supplementary Agreement," and "Supplementary Agreement (II)." Shuwei Consulting Company issued the "Cost Appraisal Report" (Chuan Shuwei (2019) Zao Jian No. 4) on September 30, 2019, with the following appraisal results: 1. The appraised amount for the lump sum portion under the "Design and Construction Contract," "Supplementary Agreement," and "Supplementary Agreement (II)" was RMB 26,146,002.97; 2. The appraised amount for the portion outside the lump sum under the above agreements was RMB 6,152,974.74; among which, the water resource extraction fee was RMB 2,282,688.38.

On March 19, 2019, and September 27, 2019, Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company transferred RMB 1 million and RMB 167,926.05, respectively, to Shuwei Consulting Company. On September 27, 2019, Shuwei Consulting Company issued 11 special VAT invoices to Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company totaling RMB 1,167,926.05.

Hongchang Jiatai Company claimed that it had paid a total of RMB 17.9 million in project funds to Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company (including Zhang Suguo), and provided corresponding transfer vouchers and receipts. During cross-examination, Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company disputed the nature of two payments totaling RMB 1 million made by Hongchang Jiatai Company on January 28, 2011, and September 6, 2011, claiming that these payments were refunds of performance bonds. It had no objection to the other payments totaling RMB 16.9 million. Upon review, the "Receipt" dated January 27, 2011, provided by Hongchang Jiatai Company stated: "Received RMB 600,000 as deposit for the Strait Friendship Building project from Hongchang Jiatai Company," handled by Zhang Suguo, and stamped with the financial seal of Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company. On January 28, 2011, Hongchang Jiatai Company transferred RMB 600,000 to Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company through Chengdu Bank. The "Receipt" dated September 1, 2011, stated: "Received RMB 400,000 as refund of performance bond for the foundation pit support works of the Strait Friendship Building (Tentative Name) project from Hongchang Jiatai Company," handled by Gu Moumou, and stamped with the financial seal of Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company. On September 6, 2011, Hongchang Jiatai Company transferred RMB 400,000 to Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company through the First Sub-branch of China Construction Bank Co., Ltd., Chengdu. The "Cash Payment Slip" indicated the source of funds as a deposit. On November 24, 2011, Hongchang Jiatai Company transferred RMB 3 million to Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company; on January 11, 2012, transferred RMB 2 million; on January 12, 2012, transferred RMB 974,786.28 and RMB 1,025,213.72 as project funds; on December 6, 2012, transferred RMB 500,000; on December 26, 2012, transferred RMB 2 million; on February 6, 2013, transferred RMB 1 million; on August 15, 2013, transferred RMB 1 million; on October 28, 2013, transferred RMB 1 million; on January 20, 2014, transferred RMB 2 million; on May 19, 2014, transferred RMB 1 million; on February 16, 2015, transferred two payments of RMB 500,000 each to Zhang Suguo; on August 14, 2015, transferred RMB 400,000 to Zhang Suguo. Zhang Suguo issued two IOUs to Hongchang Jiatai Company on February 15, 2015, and August 14, 2015, borrowing RMB 1 million and RMB 400,000 respectively, for the purpose of paying workers' wages.

The total cost of the works completed by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company in this case was RMB 32,298,977.71 (RMB 26,146,002.97 + RMB 6,152,974.74). The project funds paid by Hongchang Jiatai Company to Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company amounted to RMB 16.9 million, and it still owed Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company project funds of RMB 15,398,977.71. The parties did not conduct a settlement.

On September 17, 2019, the court of first instance accepted the case of Chengdu Construction Engineering Group Co., Ltd. v. Hongchang Jiatai Company regarding a dispute over a construction project contract, under case number (2018) Chuan 01 Min Chu No. 3286.

In summary, pursuant to Article 94, Item 4, Article 97, and Article 286 of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China, the court of first instance rendered the civil judgment (2020) Chuan 01 Min Chu No. 340 on July 20, 2020: 1. The "Design and Construction Contract for the Foundation Pit Support, Dewatering, and Earthwork Excavation and Transportation Project of the Strait Friendship Building (Tentative Name) Project" signed on October 27, 2010, the "Supplementary Agreement for the Foundation Pit Support, Dewatering, and Earthwork Excavation and Transportation Project of the Strait Friendship Building (Tentative Name) Project" signed on April 18, 2013, and the "Supplementary Agreement (II) for the Foundation Pit Support, Dewatering, and Earthwork Excavation and Transportation Project of the Strait Friendship Building (Tentative Name) Project" signed on July 18, 2013, between Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company and Hongchang Jiatai Company are terminated; 2. Hongchang Jiatai Company shall, within fifteen days from the effective date of this judgment, pay to Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company project funds of RMB 15,398,977.71; 3. All other claims of Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company are dismissed. If the obligation to pay money is not fulfilled within the period specified in this judgment, interest on the debt for delayed performance shall be doubled in accordance with Article 253 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China. The court acceptance fee of RMB 232,181 shall be borne by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company in the amount of RMB 139,426.28 and by Hongchang Jiatai Company in the amount of RMB 92,754.72. The appraisal fee of RMB 1,167,926.05 shall be borne by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company in the amount of RMB 583,963.02 and by Hongchang Jiatai Company in the amount of RMB 583,963.03. This appraisal fee has been paid by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company, and Hongchang Jiatai Company shall pay it to Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company together with the obligation under the judgment.

Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company refused to accept the judgment of first instance and appealed, requesting: 1. To set aside the judgment of first instance; 2. To revise the judgment so that Hongchang Jiatai Company bears liquidated damages (calculated at a daily rate of 0.05% on the basis of the unpaid project funds of RMB 9,246,002.97, from September 18, 2014, until the date the project funds are fully paid, provisionally calculated as of August 4, 2020, with the liquidated damages amount being RMB 9,930,207.22); 3. To revise the judgment so that Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company enjoys a priority right to claim payment for the project funds of RMB 15,398,977.71 against the proceeds from the auction or valuation of the Strait Friendship Building project developed by Hongchang Jiatai Company; 4. The litigation costs of the first and second instance shall be borne by Hongchang Jiatai Company.

The court of second instance confirmed the facts found by the court of first instance. It also found that on November 11, 2020, the Chengdu Intermediate People's Court of Sichuan Province rendered the civil ruling (2020) Chuan 01 Po No. 18, ruling to accept the application for bankruptcy liquidation of Hongchang Jiatai Company filed by Sichuan Jiuhongchang Import and Export Trading Co., Ltd., and appointed Beijing Weiheng (Chengdu) Law Firm and the Sichuan Branch of Asia Pacific (Group) Certified Public Accountants as the bankruptcy administrators.

The court of second instance held that: 1. Whether Hongchang Jiatai Company should bear liability for breach of contract for delayed payment. According to the terms of the "Design and Construction Contract," "Supplementary Agreement," and "Supplementary Agreement (II)" involved in the case, payment of the main project price required simultaneous satisfaction of the conditions of "completion, acceptance and written confirmation, and settlement completion." Based on the facts found by the court of first instance, Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company had not yet completed the work and had never conducted settlement; thus, the court of first instance determined the project price involved in the case through appraisal. Since Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company and Hongchang Jiatai Company had not settled accounts, and Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company failed to provide evidence proving that as of September 18, 2014, Hongchang Jiatai Company owed it RMB 9,246,002.97 in project progress payments, Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company's claim demanding that Hongchang Jiatai Company bear liability for breach of contract for delayed payment could not be established, and the court of first instance's rejection of such claim was not improper. 2. Whether Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company should be entitled to priority compensation with respect to the project price of RMB 15,398,977.71 for its construction scope against the auction or conversion proceeds of the project involved in the case. According to Article 286 of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China, the contractor's priority right to compensation for the construction project price extends only to the completed buildings and structures themselves, and not to the land use rights to which they are attached. In this case, the relevant work performed by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company essentially involved altering the existing condition of the land on which the proposed buildings were to be constructed, without forming separate buildings or structures that could be auctioned or sold. Therefore, Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company's claim for priority compensation for the project price was not supported. In light of the new fact that Hongchang Jiatai Company had entered bankruptcy proceedings during the second instance, the settlement of claims and debts in this case must be handled collectively through the bankruptcy proceedings. This case only confirms the creditor's claims asserted against Hongchang Jiatai Company.

In summary, pursuant to Articles 16 and 46 of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China, and Subparagraph 2 of Paragraph 1 of Article 170 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the court of second instance rendered a civil judgment on December 31, 2020 (Case No. (2020) Chuan Min Zhong 1582): 1. Affirmed Items 1 and 3 of the civil judgment of the Chengdu Intermediate People's Court of Sichuan Province (Case No. (2020) Chuan 01 Min Chu 340); 2. Modified Item 2 of the said civil judgment to read: "It is confirmed that as of November 11, 2020, Sichuan Zhongcheng Coal Construction (Group) Co., Ltd. holds a creditor's right of RMB 15,398,977.71 for the project price against Chengdu Hongchang Jiatai Real Estate Co., Ltd." After this judgment takes effect, Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company shall declare the above creditor's right and exercise its rights in accordance with the procedures prescribed by the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China. The court fees of first instance and appraisal fees shall be enforced in accordance with the method set forth in the first instance judgment. The court fees of second instance in the amount of RMB 168,445.92 shall be borne by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company.

During the retrial proceedings, Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company submitted the following evidence to this Court:

The first group of evidence consists of subcontract information, including: 1. The "Design and Construction Contract"; 2. The "Supplementary Agreement"; 3. The "Supplementary Agreement (II)". The relevant terms of the above contracts were intended to prove that the deep foundation pit project involved in the case was an inseparable part of the main building construction, and the results of the deep foundation pit project were materialized into the entire building.

The second group of evidence consists of industry standards, specifications, and relevant regulations, including: 4. "Technical Specification for Safety of Building Deep Foundation Pit Engineering (JGJ311-2013)"; 5. "Code for Deformation Measurement of Building and Structure (JGJ8-2016)"; 6. "Technical Code for Building Slope Engineering (GB50330-2013)"; 7. "Technical Code for Engineering of Rock Bolt and Shotcrete Support (GB50086-2015)"; 8. "Technical Specification for Testing of Building Foundation in Sichuan Province (DBJ51/T014-2013)"; 9. "Code for Acceptance of Construction Quality of Building Slope Engineering in Sichuan Province (DBJ51/T044-2015)"; 10. "Technical Code for Safety of Foundation Pit Engineering in Chengdu Area (DB51/T5072-2011)"; 11. Excerpt from the second edition of the "Foundation Pit Engineering Handbook" published by China Building Industry Press; 12. "Practical Design and Construction Manual for Foundation and Foundation" published by China Building Industry Press; 13. "Safety Management Regulations for Sub-projects with High Risk"; 14. "Notice of the General Office of the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development on Issues Concerning the Implementation of the 'Safety Management Regulations for Sub-projects with High Risk'"; 15. "Notice of Chengdu Construction Committee on Issuing the 'Administrative Measures for Deep Foundation Pit Construction of Building Engineering in Chengdu'". The relevant contents of the above specifications and regulations were intended to prove that foundation pit engineering is part of the building foundation engineering and is closely integrated with the main building project. In principle, deep foundation pit engineering is subject to general contracting management of building engineering. If the construction unit indeed needs to separately contract a foundation pit project with a depth exceeding five meters, it must obtain a construction permit for building engineering (deep foundation pit) to ensure the quality and safety of the deep foundation pit project, which is difficult and highly dangerous.

The third group of evidence consists of relevant documents, photographs, and other materials concerning the overview of the deep foundation pit project involved in the case, including: 16. Photographs of the deep foundation pit construction process of the Strait Friendship Building and the excavation layout plan; 17. "Construction Organization Design for Foundation Pit Earthwork, Retaining Wall, and Dewatering of Strait Friendship Building"; 18. "Scheme Design for Foundation Pit Earthwork, Retaining Wall, and Dewatering of Strait Friendship Building" and "Reinforcement Plan for Foundation Pit Retaining Wall of Strait Friendship Building (Tentative Name)"; 19. "Budget Report for Construction Drawings of the Lingyue Center (Project Name: Strait Friendship Building) (Considering Fine Decoration)"; 20. "Consultation Opinion Letter on Construction Organization Design for Deep Foundation Pit Engineering" and "Consultation Opinion Letter on Deep Foundation Pit Engineering"; 21. The "Construction Permit for Building Engineering" for the foundation pit project involved in the case; 22. Official letters formed between Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company and Hongchang Jiatai Company regarding the foundation pit earthwork project, working liaison letters for Strait Friendship Building (Tentative Name), and work contact sheets; 23. "Foundation Pit Support Handover Acceptance Form" and "Site Status Confirmation Process Form for (Project Acceptance and Valuation)"; 24. "Minutes of the Strait Friendship Building Project Supervision Meeting (Sixth Session)"; 25. "Working Liaison Letter on Extending the Time for Tube Well Dewatering"; 26. "Liaison Letter on Extension of Water Abstraction Permit"; 27. "Agreement on Building Site Dewatering". The above evidence was intended to prove that the deep foundation pit project involved in the case was an indispensable part of the entire civil construction of the Strait Friendship Building and was affected by the overall building design scheme, rather than a simple leveling and excavation of land.

The fourth group of evidence consists of materials on the current status of the Strait Friendship Building project involved in the case, including: 28. A video of the current status of Strait Friendship Building, a "Notarial Deed," the first instance evidence list, and two photographs. This evidence was intended to prove that during the construction of Strait Friendship Building, Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company coordinated with the general contractor, and the support and dewatering work in the deep foundation pit ran through the entire construction project and is still ongoing.

The fifth group of evidence consists of judgments in related cases, namely: 29. Civil Judgment of the Chengdu Intermediate People's Court of Sichuan Province (Case No. (2018) Chuan 01 Min Chu 3286). This judgment was intended to prove that the court had confirmed that the general contractor of the Strait Friendship Building involved in the case enjoyed priority compensation for the project price, including dewatering fees, and that Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company, having coordinated with the general contractor, should also enjoy priority compensation.

The sixth group of evidence consists of reference case information, including: 30. Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court (Case No. (2017) Zui Gao Fa Min Zhong 410); 31. Civil Judgment of the Hainan High People's Court (Case No. (2017) Qiong Min Zhong 336); 32. Civil Ruling of the Supreme People's Court (Case No. (2018) Zui Gao Fa Min Shen 2301).

During the retrial hearing, witnesses Li Yaojia, Chief Engineer of MCC Chengdu Survey and Research Institute Co., Ltd., and Wang Xin, Assistant General Manager of China Southwest Geotechnical Investigation & Design Institute Co., Ltd., who were applied by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company, appeared in court to testify. The two witnesses stated that deep foundation pit engineering is part of construction engineering, that buildings consist of above-ground and underground structures, and that deep foundation pit engineering is an inseparable part of basement construction; the deep foundation pit of Strait Friendship Building could only be used for this project.

In its cross-examination, Hongchang Jiatai Company argued that: Regarding the first group of evidence, it had no objection to authenticity and legality but objected to relevance; regarding the second group of evidence, it had no objection to authenticity, but the evidence did not constitute proof of the facts of the case, and the court should decide whether to adopt it; regarding evidence 16 in the third group, it had no objection to the authenticity of the construction techniques described but could not verify the accuracy of the data therein. It had objections to the authenticity of evidence 17 but acknowledged the authenticity of evidence 21 and 27. As for evidence 18-20, it requested the court to confirm their authenticity in accordance with the law. Regarding evidence 22-26, it confirmed that letters and meetings reflected in evidence 22-26 had occurred, but the bankruptcy administrator had not taken over the relevant originals, making it impossible to confirm whether the copies were consistent with the originals; it had no objection to the authenticity and legality of the fourth group of evidence; it did not accept the relevance of the fifth group of evidence; it accepted the authenticity and legality of the sixth group of evidence but noted that it was not evidence in this case.

This Court held that although Hongchang Jiatai Company could not confirm the authenticity of evidence 16-20 and 22-26, it did not provide rebutting evidence. Moreover, the above evidence could corroborate other evidence or contained information about the compiling entity for verification. This Court recognized the authenticity of the evidence provided by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company. The content of the relevant evidence and whether it could prove Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company's claims will be discussed in the reasoning section of this judgment.

Hongchang Jiatai Company did not submit any evidence.

This Court finds through the retrial: On November 5, 2010, the Planning and Construction Bureau of Chengdu High-tech Industrial Development Zone issued a "Construction Permit for Building Engineering" for the earthwork excavation and transportation, foundation pit support, and dewatering work performed by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company. According to evidence 17-18, the depth of the deep foundation pit involved in the case was changed from the originally designed 17 meters to 19.1 meters. According to evidence 19, the construction drawing budget for the Strait Friendship Building project involved in the case was RMB 1.5186 billion, of which earthwork, foundation pit support, and dewatering, which were directly subcontracted by Hongchang Jiatai Company, had a budget of RMB 26 million, included within the total budget.

Both Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company and Hongchang Jiatai Company acknowledged that Chengdu Construction Engineering Group Co., Ltd. should also have priority compensation for the project price of the Strait Friendship Building project involved in the case.

This Court confirms the other facts found by the courts of first and second instance. Additionally, the evidence submitted by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company to prove the relationship between the deep foundation pit project and the above-ground building and other facts will be discussed in the reasoning section of this judgment, in conjunction with the relevant evidence.

This Court held in the retrial that the focus of the dispute in this case is: whether the foundation pit support, dewatering, earthwork excavation and transportation work performed by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company constitutes a construction project, and whether Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company is entitled to priority compensation from the proceeds of the conversion or auction of the Strait Friendship Building project involved in the case for the unpaid project price of RMB 15,398,977.71.

Article 286 of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "If the发包人 fails to pay the price as agreed, the contractor may urge the发包人 to pay the price within a reasonable time limit. If the发包or fails to pay within the time limit, unless the nature of the construction project is not suitable for conversion or auction, the contractor may agree with the发包or to convert the project into money, or may apply to the people's court for auction of the project in accordance with the law. The price of the construction project shall be paid in priority from the proceeds of the conversion or auction of the project." Article 17 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes over Construction Project Contracts (II) provides: "If a contractor who has entered into a construction project contract with the发包or requests, in accordance with Article 286 of the Contract Law, that the price of its constructed project be paid in priority from the proceeds of the conversion or auction of the project, the people's court shall support it." Article 18 provides: "If a contractor of a decoration and renovation project requests that the price of the decoration and renovation project be paid in priority from the proceeds of the conversion or auction of the decoration and renovation project, the people's court shall support it, unless the发包or of the decoration and renovation project is not the owner of the building." Paragraph 1 of Article 21 provides: "The scope of a contractor's priority compensation for the price of a construction project shall be determined in accordance with the provisions of the relevant administrative departments of the State Council on the scope of the price of a construction project." From the above provisions, it can be seen that the project completed by a contractor entitled to priority compensation under Article 286 of the Contract Law is not limited to a separate building or structure. For example, contractors of decoration and renovation projects are also entitled to priority compensation. For the same construction project, due to different technical engineering content, the need for multiple investments, and other reasons, it is common to have multiple contractors. As long as the project completed by the contractor is a construction project and the jointly completed construction project is suitable for conversion or auction, the contractor's priority compensation should be protected in accordance with the law.

In this case, according to industry standards, specifications, and relevant regulations provided by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company (evidence 4-15), the "Technical Specification for Safety of Building Deep Foundation Pit Engineering (JGJ311-2013)" was compiled by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development in accordance with the requirements of the "Notice on Issuing the Plan for Formulation, Revision, and Planning of Engineering Construction Standards in 2011." The main content of the specification is that deep foundation pit construction includes support structure construction, groundwater and surface water control, earthwork excavation, etc. The technical specifications for deep foundation pit construction shall comply with relevant administrative regulations for construction projects. Testing of building foundations includes testing of foundation pit (slope) projects, i.e., support structure construction. Design data for the main structure, including general building plans, floor plans for each level of building and structure, are indispensable for the design of foundation pit support structures. All buildings require a solid foundation, the cost of which can account for one-fifth or even one-third of a building's total cost. Earthwork excavation, support, and dewatering of foundation pits with an excavation depth exceeding five meters (including five meters), i.e., deep foundation pit projects, are sub-projects with a certain scale and high risk in building construction. According to Article 5 of the "Administrative Measures for Deep Foundation Pit Construction of Building Engineering in Chengdu," deep foundation pit projects shall, in principle, be subject to the general contracting management of the building project. If the construction unit indeed needs to separately contract a foundation pit project with a depth exceeding five meters, it must obtain a construction permit for building engineering (deep foundation pit). In this case, the foundation pit of the Strait Friendship Building involved in the case had a depth of 19.1 meters. Hongchang Jiatai Company contracted the foundation pit support, dewatering, earthwork excavation and transportation work of the project to Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company for construction. Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company obtained a "Construction Permit for Building Engineering" for its construction work. Chengdu Construction Engineering Group Co., Ltd. was the general contractor of the Strait Friendship Building involved in the case, responsible for the construction of the main project. According to the relevant terms of the "Design and Construction Contract," "Supplementary Agreement," and "Supplementary Agreement (II)" entered into between Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company and Hongchang Jiatai Company, the scheme design drawings for the foundation pit and other works constructed by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company were subject to review by Hongchang Jiatai Company and the special group and were subject to their inspection; Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company had to comply with the management of Party A, the supervision party, and the general contractor. The foundation pit support, dewatering, and earthwork excavation and transportation work it performed had to be completed on schedule and undergo acceptance and written confirmation by Party A, the supervision party, the general contractor, and relevant functional departments before settlement. According to evidence 19, the construction drawing budget for the project involved in the case was RMB 1.5186 billion, which included the budget of RMB 26 million for the project contracted by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company. According to evidence 23-25, after delivering the foundation pit retaining wall project to the general contractor, Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company continued to participate in the project supervision meetings. The meeting minutes required Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company to be included in the management scope of the general contractor and to continue the dewatering work of the tube wells; to meet construction needs and ensure building safety, the dewatering of the tube wells around the foundation pit needed to continue until backfilling. The above facts demonstrate that the foundation pit support, dewatering, and earthwork excavation and transportation work performed by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company, from design to specific construction, were closely connected with the general contractor, tightly coordinated and interwoven with the construction of the main project, and were indispensable parts of the construction project of the Strait Friendship Building involved in the case. Throughout the construction process, the building materials and labor invested by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company were materialized into the entire building of the Strait Friendship Building project involved in the case and were inseparable from the building. Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company, as the contractor that entered into a construction project contract with the发包or Hongchang Jiatai Company, is entitled to priority compensation from the proceeds of the conversion or auction of the Strait Friendship Building project involved in the case, up to the amount of the unpaid project price of RMB 15,398,977.71. The courts of first and second instance found that the substance of the work performed by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company was a change to the existing condition of the land on which the proposed buildings were to be constructed, without forming separate buildings or structures, and objectively did not meet the conditions for exercising the priority right to compensation for the construction project price. This constituted errors in fact-finding and application of law, which this Court hereby corrects.

In this case, Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company's project price included water abstraction resource fees in the amount of RMB 2,282,688.38. Article 3 of the "Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Priority Right to Compensation for Construction Project Prices" provides: "The price of a construction project includes the remuneration for workers, material costs, and other actual expenses paid by the contractor for the construction project, but does not include losses caused by the发包or's breach of contract." Article 5 of the "Interim Provisions on the Management of Prices for Construction Project Contracting and Subcontracting" issued by the former Ministry of Construction provides that the project price consists of costs (direct costs, indirect costs), profits (fees), and taxes. In this case, according to the "Water Abstraction Permit," "Application for Change of Water Abstraction Permit," and other evidence submitted by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company, combined with the fact found by the court of first instance that Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company had been performing dewatering for the project involved in the case, the water abstraction resource fees should be actual expenses paid by Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company for the construction project and form part of the direct costs of the construction project price. According to Article 21 of the "Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes over Construction Project Contracts (II)" and Article 5 of the "Interim Provisions on the Management of Prices for Construction Project Contracting and Subcontracting," the water abstraction resource fees, as part of the construction project price, should fall within the scope of priority compensation. Hongchang Jiatai Company's claim that the water abstraction resource fees should not be included in the scope of priority compensation is not supported by this Court.

Both parties acknowledge that the contractors for the project involved in the case are Chengdu Construction Engineering Group Co., Ltd. and Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company; the case of Chengdu Construction Engineering Group Co., Ltd. v. Hongchang Jiatai Company concerning a dispute over a construction project contract is currently under trial in the second instance; the Strait Friendship Building involved in the case has been suspended, currently in the state where the basement level four and above-ground level four have been completed, with level five having begun preliminary construction. Therefore, Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company is not the only constructor entitled to priority compensation from the proceeds of the conversion or auction of the Strait Friendship Building involved in the case.

In summary, the retrial requests of Zhongcheng Coal Construction Company are established and are supported by this Court. In accordance with Paragraph 1 of Article 207 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Subparagraph 2 of Paragraph 1 of Article 170 thereof, the judgment is as follows:

1. Set aside the Civil Judgment of Sichuan High People's Court (2020) Chuan Min Zhong No. 1582 and the Civil Judgment of Chengdu Intermediate People's Court, Sichuan Province (2020) Chuan 01 Min Chu No. 340;

2. Rescind the Design and Construction Contract for Foundation Pit Support, Dewatering, Earthwork and Muck Excavation and Transportation of the Strait Friendship Building (Provisional Name) Project entered into between Sichuan Zhongcheng Coal Construction (Group) Co., Ltd. and Chengdu Hongchang Jiatai Real Estate Co., Ltd. on October 27, 2010, the Supplemental Agreement for Foundation Pit Support, Dewatering, Earthwork and Muck Excavation and Transportation of the Strait Friendship Building (Provisional Name) Project entered into on April 18, 2013, and the Supplemental Agreement (Part II) for Foundation Pit Support, Dewatering, Earthwork and Muck Excavation and Transportation of the Strait Friendship Building (Provisional Name) Project entered into on July 18, 2013;

3. Confirm that as of November 11, 2020, Sichuan Zhongcheng Coal Construction (Group) Co., Ltd. holds a claim for project payment in the amount of RMB 15,398,977.71 against Chengdu Hongchang Jiatai Real Estate Co., Ltd., and enjoys a priority right of reimbursement from the proceeds of the discount or auction of the Strait Friendship Building project within the scope of the said project payment;

4. Dismiss the other claims of Sichuan Zhongcheng Coal Construction (Group) Co., Ltd..

After this judgment takes effect, Sichuan Zhongcheng Coal Construction (Group) Co., Ltd. shall declare the above-mentioned claim and exercise its rights in accordance with the procedures prescribed by the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China.

Court costs of first instance in the amount of RMB 232,181 shall be borne by Sichuan Zhongcheng Coal Construction (Group) Co., Ltd. in the amount of RMB 139,426.28 and by Chengdu Hongchang Jiatai Real Estate Co., Ltd. in the amount of RMB 92,754.72. Appraisal fees in the amount of RMB 1,167,926.05 shall be borne by Sichuan Zhongcheng Coal Construction (Group) Co., Ltd. in the amount of RMB 583,963.02 and by Chengdu Hongchang Jiatai Real Estate Co., Ltd. in the amount of RMB 583,963.03. Court costs of second instance in the amount of RMB 168,445.92 shall be borne by Sichuan Zhongcheng Coal Construction (Group) Co., Ltd. in the amount of RMB 66,038.56 and by Chengdu Hongchang Jiatai Real Estate Co., Ltd. in the amount of RMB 102,407.36.

This judgment is final.
